t: Maximum Score After Applying Operations on a Tree
o: We may collect (zero out) any nodes' values, but the tree stays 'healthy': every root-to-leaf path must retain a positive sum. Maximize collected value. Example 2: collecting everything except a set of nodes that keeps all paths positive yields 40. Key observation: if we keep (don't collect) a node u, the healthiness of paths through u into u's subtree can be delegated downward; if we collect u, we may also collect its entire subtree freely ONLY IF some kept node above still covers those paths — actually collecting u forces us to reconsider: the clean DP is: f(u) = best score in u's subtree given the path above u is already handled, choosing either (a) collect u and everything below (gain total subtree sum), or (b) keep u and recursively optimize children. Wait — collecting u zeroes the path through it, so ancestors must cover; the recursion f(u) = max(total(u), values[u] + Σ f(child)) captures exactly this: option (a) collects the whole subtree (paths from root through u to leaves become 0 unless an ancestor is kept — and the ancestor's option (b) pays for it), option (b) keeps u making every path through u positive by itself.
k: f(u) = max(subtree total, values[u] + Σ f(children)) — collect-all vs keep-and-recurse.
Keeping a node makes all root-to-leaf paths through it healthy regardless of ancestors.

a.i: Each node independently chooses: take its entire subtree sum (zero everything below including itself), or keep its own value and add children's optimal answers. Taking the max at the root is optimal because subtree choices don't interact beyond this.
a.sp: O(n) for adjacency and recursion stack

a.n: Approach 2: Iterative DFS with explicit stack
a.i: Identical recurrence, but processed post-order with a stack to avoid recursion-depth issues on skewed trees in languages with small stacks.
s: On second visit, combine children results stored in a map

w: Present the DP as 'collect whole subtree vs keep this node' — interviewers accept it quickly once you argue kept nodes independently guarantee health. Values reach 10⁹ × 2·10⁴ nodes, so use 64-bit sums. Pitfall: leaves need no special case with this formulation. Follow-up: what if health required path sum ≥ T?
